layout: Monaco Grand Prix 3.337km/19-corner street circuit; tunnel below the Fairmont complex.
sector_registration: All stations in retained native origin. Approximate full-route zones; individual decor must stay beyond verified protection and runoff.

sectors.name: Pit straight and Sainte-Dévote
sectors.observed_environment: Stands and stone/pink apartment tiers frame the uphill opening. Pit/service bars, marina edge, Armco and high mesh fence. Sainte-Dévote needs its opening/runoff access, not a solid urban wall.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Beau Rivage, Massenet and Casino
sectors.observed_environment: Steep uphill street with continuous inhabited facades, stepped retaining walls, trees and upper hillside apartments. Casino/Hotel de Paris geometry needs targeted review; overview has no reliable close view.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Mirabeau, Fairmont and Portier
sectors.observed_environment: Tight descending sequence between pale hotel/apartment walls and planted terraces; palms and close red/white kerbs. Fairmont compound is a broad terraced hotel, not a freestanding tower. Bridge/overhang near hairpin seen, exact assignment needs registration.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Tunnel
sectors.observed_environment: Road is below the Fairmont podium and sea-facing gallery. Preserve drivable deck elevation independently from roof heights. Overview does not directly show interior lighting, so tunnel cross-section/portal details need targeted frames.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Nouvelle chicane and harbour edge
sectors.observed_environment: Harbour yachts, masts and large moored vessel silhouettes, steep apartment-covered slopes behind. Exposed pale rock cliff/retaining wall on inland side; red/white chicane islands and close Armco.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Tabac and swimming pool
sectors.observed_environment: Marina water and yachts opposite close white multi-level balcony facades and apartment terraces. Low harbour structures and grandstands; linked short kerbs with narrow escape corridors.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Rascasse, Antony Noghès and pits
sectors.observed_environment: Constricted final turns between harbour hospitality and pit structures; roof/canopy layering, guardrail returns and pedestrian gaps. Final corner feeds directly into confined pit straight.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.
